notes.title: August 21, 2025 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello, Survivors! 🧟🥽
[/b][/p][p]Today, we are releasing the first patch for World War Z VR, which includes several bug fixes and additional polish for both Steam and Meta platforms.
[/p][p]If you encounter any issues, make sure to submit a ticket to our support team: [/p][p][url="https://support.saber.games/hc/en/world-war-z-vr/articles/how-to-report-an-issue-6"]https://support.saber.games/hc/en/world-war-z-vr/articles/how-to-report-an-issue-6[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]If you experience any performance-related issues on Steam, we recommend checking this article:[/p][p][url="https://support.saber.games/hc/en/world-war-z-vr/articles/performance-issue-troubleshooting-steam-5"]https://support.saber.games/hc/en/world-war-z-vr/articles/performance-issue-troubleshooting-steam-5[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Check the full details below! ⤵️[/b][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637385/035d67d96eba177abc65301328d76d68a156183e.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Resolved Issues[/b][/h2][h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed various issues where the game softlocked the player from continuing different missions or finishing them.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where the weapon could fall on the floor - The timer before weapons dissolved and appeared in the holster decreased to 0.25. Players could not interact with the holster before the weapon fully appeared in it.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed animation issues with the revolver, causing it to stop closing the barrel after several bullets were removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue with the dead swarm zombies that continued following their predetermined paths.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed mission controller models in the calibration menu for HTC and Index VR headsets.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various minor issues and bugs.
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Performance and Graphical issues[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed freezes happening on the loading screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the transparent silhouette of the timer bomb appearing in the Cathedral doors before the arena.[/p][/*][*][p]Zombie's hair is now working correctly (the 3D effect is on).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing shadows for the zombies on New York 3.[/p][/*][*][p]Restored mission background for Tokyo 3.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed visual bugs with doors and tarpaulin in the planetarium.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed visual glitches where items appeared and disappeared in front of the player when they moved around. LODs fix on New York 1 and 2, Tokyo 3 and 4, and Marseille 1 and 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with lighting in the ambulance in New York 1 - Light sources inside the ambulance are removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed invisible legs for a stationary machine gun.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the highlight of the soldier's leg in the main menu location.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed lighting and reflection issues with the trees in Tokyo 1. Excess light source was removed.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: World War Z VR - OUT NOW!
notes.notes:

notes.title: World War Z VR - Coming August 12!
notes.notes:
[p]The swarms are back for more in World War Z VR! Coming to Steam VR on August 12.🧟🥽 

Feel the gore and immersive chaos like never before with:

[b]🧟 Battle Hordes of Zombies in VR:[/b] Endure overwhelming swarms of more than 200 zombies on screen at a time in the ultimate VR zombie experience!
[b]💪 7 Playable Characters:[/b] Select your operative and dive into each mission with your pre-selected AI squad. Equip a wide variety of weapons and perks to give yourself the edge over the most gruesome firefights.
[b]🌐  Explore Vast Environments: [/b]Navigate massive levels with total immersion across three real-world locations overrun by the undead – New York, Tokyo, and Marseille.
[b]💀 Survive Epic Challenges:[/b] Zombies will adapt to their surroundings and your playstyle to hunt you down, while special infected enemies raise the stakes even higher. Choose from three difficulty modes and overcome all odds to live to fight another day!

[b]Check the announcement trailer here:[/b] [dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/4WP-4eIN6HY"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]World War Z VR is a new first-person experience designed from the ground up to capture the series’ legendary scale and action for long-time fans and VR enthusiasts alike. The gameplay mechanics of the original World War Z game have been fully reimagined for VR to deliver a gripping sense of realism and excitement with each moment.

Take on hordes of undead across vast environments in three unique locations – New York, Tokyo, and Marseille. Customize your challenge to suit your playstyle with a variety of characters, weapons, perks, and difficulty settings to choose from.

Pre-order now to receive the Golden Skin Pack bonus! ✅
